title: Ten questions with common traps, no tools
task: Answer each question exactly, without running code. Give integers as plain numbers and non-integers as reduced fractions such as 3/7.

questions.1: What are the last two digits of 7^2026? Give them as a two-digit number.
questions.2: How many trailing zeros does 2026! have?
questions.3: What is the sum of the decimal digits of 2^20?
questions.4: In how many ways can a 2 by 10 board be tiled with 1 by 2 dominoes?
questions.5: How many integers from 1 to 9999 have decimal digits that sum to 9?
questions.6: What is the expected number of rolls of a fair six-sided die needed to see all six faces at least once?
questions.7: For how many integers n from 1 to 100 is n^2 + 1 divisible by 5?
questions.8: What is the smaller angle, in degrees, between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 3:40?
questions.9: How many diagonals does a convex polygon with 20 sides have?
questions.10: What is the 100th digit after the decimal point in the decimal expansion of 1/7?
